candidates.name: Dakota Natural Gas Pipeline
candidates.from: Viking Gas Transmission interconnect near Donaldson, MN

evidence.note: Federal Register notice: about 17.3 mi of new pipeline (9.3 mi in MN) from Viking to Drayton ND, FERC CP18-511
Pipeline project article, Oct 2021
EIA row says 35 mi, CP20-155, Construction 2021

candidates.why_maybe_new: Length conflict: FERC notice 17.3 mi (27.8 km) vs EIA 35 mi; either is >= 25 km. It is a small LDC supply line serving Drayton; could be judged distribution. No roster row.

candidates.name: Dakota Pipeline (WBI Energy)

evidence.note: Planned 375-mile pipeline, 400 MMcf/d initial, ND to NW Minnesota; about $650M
EIA row: On Hold, 400 MMcf/d, cost $650M; its 24 mi figure looks like a data error

candidates.why_maybe_new: Sourced length about 375 mi (600 km), far above the EIA 24 mi. Not on roster (P0281 Williston Basin and P3584-3588 North Bakken are different projects). Starts in ND, in slice.

candidates.name: Demicks Lake pipeline project (2015-era 24-inch lateral)

evidence.note: EIA: 22 mi, 24 in, 222 MMcf/d, PF15-24, Cancelled

candidates.why_maybe_new: 22 mi = 35 km, EIA only (single origin). Distinct from the built 12.2 mi Demicks Lake-Cherry Creek lateral (CP19-27) and from P3584 North Bakken. Not on roster.

candidates.name: DEFS Carney-Kingfisher Line

evidence.note: EIA: 42 mi, 12 in, 60 MMcf/d, intrastate lateral, completed 2001-01

candidates.why_maybe_new: 42 mi = 68 km, EIA only. May be a gathering line (Duke field services) or part of an Enable/DCP system; needs vetting. Not matched to P0163 on name.

candidates.name: GLT Security Loop Project Phase II

evidence.note: Federal Register: three 36-inch loop segments totaling 24.5 mi, CP96-297
EIA: 24.5 mi, in service 1998

candidates.why_maybe_new: 24.5 mi = 39 km of 36-inch loop on P0194's mainline. P0194 is a whole-system row; expansion loops get their own rows by convention. Three discontinuous segments.

candidates.name: GLT System Wide Expansion

evidence.note: EIA: 72 mi, 36 in, +126 MMcf/d, CP96-647, MB/MN/WI/MI

candidates.why_maybe_new: EIA 72 mi, but much of the project may be compression; new-pipe length unverified. Loops of P0194. Single origin.

candidates.name: Heartland Pipeline (Indiana)

evidence.note: EIA: 25 mi, 16 in, 80 MMcf/d, intrastate, completed 2006-12

candidates.why_maybe_new: 25 mi = 40 km, EIA only. Not related to ANR Heartland Project (P7793). Endpoints unknown.
